June has 30 days, so back to 22 May 1283 (2 - 10 days = 23 May, then 30 more days back = 22 May).  
Check: From 2 June back 30 days → 3 May, then back 11 more days → 22 April? Wait, recalc carefully.  

Better:  
June 2 → back 2 days → May 31 (June 1), May 30 (June 2 minus 2 days = May 31? Actually June 2 minus 1 day = June 1, minus 2 days = May 31).  
So May 31 is 2 days back. Need 39 more days back.  
May has 31 days: from May 31 back 31 days → May 0 → April 30. That’s 33 days back total (2 + 31 = 33).  
Need 8 more days back from April 30 → April 22.  

So 41 days back from June 2, 1283 = April 22, 1283.
